key_evidence_accepted.reason: The judgment does state that the State FSL report found the forgery allegation inconclusive.

appeal_history.reason: Trial court refused discharge on 15.03.2018, High Court dismissed revision, and Supreme Court allowed appeal, all matching the judgment.

prosecution_argument.reason: Describes charges rather than the arguments actually recorded; s.173(8) plea was by respondent No. 2.

defence_argument.correct_value: Respondent No. 2 expressly consented to the passport and sponsored travel; complaint was a counterblast; State FSL was inconclusive; no new material; no prima facie case

legal_principle_applied.reason: Fraudulent/dishonest intent for cheating and forgery and the fresh-evidence requirement under s.173(8) are both applied.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: No aggravating factors against the accused are identified.
